title: Choose the visual world for navin.
question: The roll assigned Keycap Kit Sheet. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Keycap Kit Sheet
options.lineage: mechanical-keyboard keycap sets and their colorway kit sheets
options.thesis: The portfolio is a keyboard you can actually type on: sections are keys, and the opening is a race against Navin.
materials: doubleshot ABS keycaps with sculpted lips
kit-sheet spec labels and swatch legend
options.viewport: Navin's name set huge beside his portrait; nav is a row of real keycaps (P, E, S, C) with working shortcuts; an orange Esc-style key starts the 30-second race.
options.risk: Turns into a costume if everything becomes a keycap; keycaps must be reserved for actions only.

raised.raise: Quantities are the interface: 92 wpm, 98.42%, dates sit in fixed tabular fields, never loose in prose.
The kit sheet names its own colorway: a visible swatch legend governs theme, and toggling it re-colors the board.
One colorway owns every surface, light and dark both, with no stray accent outside it.

options.label: The Résumé, Typeset
options.lineage: Swiss International Style CVs and university bulletins
options.thesis: The site is the best-set résumé a recruiter will open this week.
options.viewport: Name, role and contact in a three-column header block; projects listed as numbered entries directly beneath.
options.risk: Familiar: the direction most runs in this category land on, and the typing race becomes an appendix.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: Navin's path as one itinerary: each section is a coupon that tears off in sequence.
options.viewport: A ticket wallet open on the first coupon: passenger NAVIN B. LLANES, origin LPU Manila, with legs listing projects and experience.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: experience maps to legs and verified certificates to validated coupons; holds clarity, loses on recruiter identification.
options.risk: Reads as a travel theme if the coupon fields carry no real data.

options.label: Destination Blind
options.thesis: Navigation is a destination roll: choosing a section snaps the blind to PROJECTS, EXPERIENCE, STACK.
options.viewport: One fixed window showing NAVIN in chrome-yellow caps; the roll steps a full course with an overshoot on every section change.
options.case: Holds product clarity, since section changes are unmistakable; loses on recruiter identification.
options.risk: Condensed caps at one size can flatten the hierarchy of long project descriptions.

options.label: Nixie Counter
options.thesis: Every figure arrives as a glowing digit in glass.
options.viewport: WPM and accuracy as tube banks above the name.
options.case: Fuses poorly: most of a portfolio is prose and images, not counts.
options.kept: Quantities are the interface: fixed tabular fields for every figure.

options.label: Character Reference Sheet
options.thesis: Navin drawn in four views with named swatches.
options.viewport: Four views of the portrait with a swatch row.
options.case: Fuses poorly for recruiters; undermines seriousness.
options.kept: The sheet names its own swatches, and the swatches govern regions.

options.label: Indoor Weather Sun
options.thesis: The page as one amber hall with a half sun.
options.viewport: A long horizon line with the name set low.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no link between the world and a CS portfolio.

options.label: Silk Color Chords
options.case: Fuses poorly: overlap states have no portfolio meaning.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean developer portfolio, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Photo, name and tagline split hero; a grid of project cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other student portfolios by design.
